caption:
Chopping time is the main reason juicers end up unused, so a wide chute or batch hopper matters most. Greens and wheatgrass need a masticating or twin-gear press. On the page, Claude's pick is the Nama J2 and GPT's is the Breville Juice Fountain Plus. The wheatgrass pick: 1billionmodels.com/juicers

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Juicing leafy greens? Which type of juicer to buy
